Reduce room reflections in recorded speech with a local dereverberation model.

## Current availability {#current-availability}

Desktop builds can download and authenticate the required onnxruntime-node 1.29.0 engine for macOS arm64, Linux x64, Linux arm64, Windows x64, Windows arm64. Install this model and its required runtime through Model Manager, then run its task locally. These are supported build targets; consult the nightly test report for results on a particular package and machine.

## Use this model {#use-this-model}

Open **Tools → Advanced Local Processing → Dereverberation** on a platform with the required native runtime. Local assistance runs in the desktop editor.

1. Select speech affected by room reflections.
2. Install the model through Model Manager and run dereverberation.
3. Compare the result with the original and accept it only if the speech sounds better.

## Download and requirements {#download-and-requirements}

Model identity: `dereverb-room`, version **1.0.0**.

Approximate model artifact download size: **114.57 MiB**. The required runtime adds to the first download if it is not already installed. Minimum system memory: **2 GiB**. This catalog requirement refers to total memory, not currently free memory. Inference also needs sufficient free memory, and installation needs working space; memory is not a speed guarantee.

Published platforms: macOS arm64, Linux x64, Linux arm64, Windows x64, Windows arm64. A matching downloadable runtime is also required.

On Windows, install the latest supported [Microsoft Visual C++ v14 Redistributable](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist?view=msvc-170) matching the desktop app: **x64** for an x64 build or **ARM64** for an ARM64 build. The native ONNX and Sherpa engines require these libraries; model and runtime downloads do not include them. Visual Studio itself is not required to use the app.

Tools → Model Manager downloads the published model artifacts and required runtime on first installation, and verifies their recorded SHA-256 digests. Processing uses the installed files locally. Open Storage and verification in Model Manager to inspect notices, repair an installation, or change the storage location.

| Artifact | Approximate download size |
| --- | --- |
| network.onnx | 114.57 MiB |

## What the desktop test checks {#what-the-packaged-test-checks}

Case: `dereverb-room-speech`; operation: `dereverberation`.

Input: The Kennedy speech resampled to 44.1 kHz with four reproducible delayed reflections.

Decoded audio must contain finite samples, preserve the expected audio geometry, differ from the input samples, and have a nonzero audible signal. Different file headers alone do not count as a change.

The nightly-with-tests package downloads real model artifacts and verified runtimes before inference. A required model missing from the catalog fails its case. Missing native engines fail on catalog-supported platforms. These costly checks run separately from the normal browser suite. A passing run confirms basic model execution and usable output structure; it does not establish perceptual quality or accuracy on your recording.

## Review the result {#review-the-result}

- Strong reflections, music, and unfamiliar rooms can produce artifacts or remove wanted detail.
- Changed, non-silent audio confirms processing, not complete reverb removal or perceptual improvement.
- The model declares GPL-3.0; preserve its license and corresponding-source directions when redistributing it. The dry training corpus and base-checkpoint lineage are unknown.
